title: Sample call rate

blocks.what_we_do: Apply a 98% sample call-rate requirement after rough cleaning.
blocks.why: Call rate estimates completeness across the retained sites. A threshold of 98% corresponds to at most 2% missingness, not 98% missingness. Low completeness can reduce effective sample size and can be associated with laboratory or recruitment groups. Compare the distribution before adopting the threshold in another study.
blocks.command:
```{r s3-2}
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "3.1"), "--mind", "0.02", "--make-pgen", "--out", guided_path(cfg, "3.2")))
ops <- guided_replay_lists(cfg, "3.2", "3.1")
guided_register(cfg, "3.2", "3.1", 1971, 296360, operations = ops)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s3-1_state --mind 0.02 --make-pgen --out results/guided/s3-2_state --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--mind 0.02` filters samples with more than 2% missing calls, equivalent to call rate below 98%. `--pfile` selects the input native fileset; `--make-pgen` saves a new state; `--out` sets its prefix. `--threads 2` limits worker threads. `--memory 2048` sets the workspace budget in MiB.
blocks.expected_result:
42 additional wells removed; 1,971 samples and 296,360 variants remain.



The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.what_this_check_can_reveal: Moderate sample failures that survived the rough screen. Missingness may be related to case/control status or batch, so exclusions must be documented.
blocks.quick_check:
A well with 1% missing calls has what call rate, and does it pass this rule?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

99%; it passes the 98% call-rate requirement.

</details>
